chars.HIM: a Moroccan man, 24, short black curly hair, light beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and black joggers
chars.HER: a young Moroccan woman, 22, long dark wavy hair, wearing a lilac oversized sweater, light blue jeans and small gold hoop earrings
chars.CLASSMATE: a young Moroccan woman, 23, wearing a black hijab and a beige trench coat
chars.FRIENDS: two young Moroccan women, one in a red puffer jacket with a high ponytail, one in a white denim jacket with short bob hair

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: HER sitting on her bed at night, secretly scrolling her phone and tilting the screen away with a guilty sideways glance, seen from the half-open bedroom doorway, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, warm lamp light, 2D flat cartoon style

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: close shot of HER hands holding a phone showing a private social media profile with a lock icon and a few small round profile pictures (no readable text), her worried face blurred in the background, 2D flat cartoon style

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: HER on a video call in her room, holding the phone in front of her face, shrugging casually and smiling too innocently, waving her free hand as if to say it is nothing, 2D flat cartoon style

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: HIM and CLASSMATE sitting side by side at a small cafe table, CLASSMATE typing a search on her phone while HIM leans in watching the screen intently, cups of coffee on the table, 2D flat cartoon style

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: HIM frozen in shock with wide eyes and open mouth, staring at the phone that CLASSMATE turns toward him, CLASSMATE raising her eyebrows, cafe background, 2D flat cartoon style

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: HIM standing alone in a small bedroom at night, phone pressed to his ear, frowning and gesturing angrily with his free hand, tense mood, 2D flat cartoon style

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: HER with FRIENDS on the seaside corniche of Tangier with the sea and white buildings behind them, the three laughing and taking a selfie together, sunny day, 2D flat cartoon style

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: HER on the phone in a hotel room, rolling her eyes defensively, one hand on her hip, a small suitcase open on the bed behind her, 2D flat cartoon style

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: HIM sitting at a desk at night under a lamp, determined detective look, scrolling through a phone with narrowed eyes, sticky notes and a notebook on the desk with no readable text, 2D flat cartoon style
